Daily summary tables in the `ibm_verify_events_transformed` schema. Use these
for IBM Verify reporting.

A nightly Glue job builds them from the [raw event stream](ibm_verify_events_raw.qmd).
It runs at 04:00 ET and writes the previous ET day. Each table is built by one
`compute_*()` function in
[`ibm_verify_events_metrics_daily.py`](https://github.com/cds-snc/canadalogin-reporting-data-pipeline/blob/main/infra/modules/ibm_verify_events_streaming/glue_src/ibm_verify_events_metrics_daily.py).
That code is the definition of every column. The repo is internal, so the link
needs cds-snc access.

Data starts on 2026-04-22, the public launch.

## Dates are strings

`from_date` and `to_date` are `YYYY-MM-DD` strings, not timestamps. Comparing
them to a date fails with `TYPE_MISMATCH`, so cast first:

```sql
WHERE CAST(from_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
```

In R, wrap both sides in `as.Date()`:
`filter(as.Date(from_date) >= as.Date("2026-09-01"))`. A bare string on the
right fails the same way, because RAthena turns ISO-date strings into `DATE`
literals.
